subject.title: Bug: Billing error (402) causes infinite retry death spiral for inline-apiKey providers (no backoff)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider-level fail-closed cooldown state for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials, including the persisted `inline-api-key:<provider>` usage namespace?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the proposed fix creates durable auth-provider behavior for existing inline-key users and needs maintainer acceptance before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
options.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials while preserving healthy stored profiles as fallback.

options.title: Keep profile-only cooldowns
options.body: Close the implementation path as not planned and document migrating inline keys into auth profiles as the supported workaround.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify the exact cooldown identity, persistence, and recovery behavior they want.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
recommendation.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials while preserving healthy stored profiles as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and issue timeline make steipete the best available routing candidate for this auth/provider compatibility choice.
